summary.name: SOUNDRAW
summary.one_liner: SOUNDRAW is an AI music generator that creates royalty-free beats and tracks by genre, mood, or theme, with per-instrument customization.
use_cases: Creating background music for YouTube videos
Making royalty-free beats for games and apps
Generating podcast intro or background music
Producing original tracks to release on streaming services
Adding vocals or instruments to an AI-generated base track
Licensing music for business or enterprise use
summary.what_it_does: SOUNDRAW generates music from a chosen genre, mood, or theme, and lets users mix genres in one click. Users can fine-tune individual instruments, intensity, and flow, and build beats loop by loop. A browser-based mixer adjusts tempo, key, and instrument layers. The page says the AI is trained only on music produced by the company's in-house musicians, not scraped data. Stem downloads are mentioned, and the page describes commercial use for videos, games, and apps on paid plans.
notable: AI model trained only on music made by the in-house team, with no scraped data
Per-instrument, bar-level, and intensity control over generated tracks
Browser-based mixer for tempo, key, and instrument layers
Business plans with music API access and enterprise licenses
caveats: Commercial use and unlimited downloads are described for paid plans; free tier is limited
Keeping 100% of recording royalties for artist releases is tied to the Artists offering, with details behind pricing pages
Enterprise and API access are on separate business plans
